suggestions.reason: Provide the trusted MCP tool declaration if executable call correctness is intended. A.md:7 names pr-review-dismiss, and line 24 references isError; the fixture does not establish the concrete tool name or document the response envelope. Checking an error indicator does not itself invent a persistence/recovery rule, but the boundary between permitted protocol knowledge and unsupported contract assumptions should be explicit.
